summary_en: Sensh­u Dengy­o authorized acquisition of up to 75,000 shares (0.44% of outstanding shares) for a maximum 6.0 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027 to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Sensh­u Dengy­o's board of directors resolved on October 28, 2026 to acquire treasury stock in accordance with Article 156 of the Companies Act, as applied by substitution under Article 165, paragraph 3. The company will acquire up to 75,000 shares of its common stock through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027. The maximum acquisition price is set at 6.0 billion yen, with an implied per-share ceiling of approximately 8,000 yen. The authorized shares represent 0.44% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), calculated against 17,020,209 shares as of October 27, 2026.

The stated purpose is to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency while enabling flexible capital policy in response to changes in the operating environment. This acquisition framework allows the company to execute buybacks opportunistically within the specified parameters during the six-month authorization period.
